subject: Eval credits request — OptiVize RFP (competitive bakeoff)
messages:
From: Anika Singh <anika@optivize.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marty Chen <marty.chen@optivize.com>, procurement@optivize.com
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request: additional eval credits and short extension for RFP bakeoff

Hi Markus,

Appreciate the trial access so far. We’re deep in the OptiVize RFP and have a head-to-head bakeoff against Vendor X next week. During integration we hit higher token usage than expected — the team burned through the initial allocation and still needs roughly ~200K tokens to finish the two final benchmark scenarios and run our scoring metrics.

Can Redwood provide:
- 200,000 eval credits (one-time top-up) OR
- a 30% promo credit match to what Vendor X supplied (they offered a one-off 200K)
- + a 2-week extension on the trial window so the infra team can complete the last runs

This is time-sensitive: bakeoff demo is scheduled for 2026-11-19 and procurement needs the technical results by Monday 11/23 to include in scoring. If we can get a quick yes, I’ll share a short MA plan and the final scoring rubric.

Attached: optivize-rfp-v3.pdf (RFP excerpt)

Thanks —
Anika Singh
Head of Platform Integrations
OptiVize
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
To: Anika Singh <anika@optivize.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 10:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request: additional eval credits and short extension for RFP bakeoff

Hi Anika — thanks for the context and the RFP excerpt. Really keen to help you win the bakeoff. Quick questions to size this properly:
- Can you share current consumption and the specific two scenarios that need the extra runs? (a CSV or sample output is fine)
- Are there any vendor-specific features you require that only Vendor X supports today?

I can immediately approve a 75K top-up from the growth promo budget and the 2-week extension. For a full 200K match I’ll need a discretionary exception approved by my manager (looping in Priyom for that path). If you can forward the trial usage report and a short note on expected incremental ARR if you select Redwood, that will help expedite.

Proposed immediate next steps:
1) I’ll send 75K credits now so your team can keep running.
2) If the usage report + ARR rationale looks compelling, I’ll escalate for up to 200K.

Would you like me to send a short MA plan for signatures so we can tie credits to an agreement?

Best,
Markus Klein
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
From: Anika Singh <anika@optivize.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 11 Nov 2026 08:21:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request: additional eval credits and short extension for RFP bakeoff

On Tue, Nov 10, 2026 at 10:03 AM Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Hi Anika — thanks for the context and the RFP excerpt. Really keen to help you win the bakeoff. Quick questions to size this properly:
> - Can you share current consumption and the specific two scenarios that need the extra runs? (a CSV or sample output is fine)
> - Are there any vendor-specific features you require that only Vendor X supports today?

Thanks — attached is the trial-usage-report.csv with per-scenario breakdown and an internal note on why 200K is required. Short answer on features: no, we’re testing with the same model family across vendors — it’s purely throughput/quality. If Redwood can do 200K + extension we’ll list that in procurement scoring and it materially shifts the conversation.

We’re happy to sign a short MA plan (non-binding) that confirms evaluation scope and a 12-month intent to discuss committed capacity if results meet SLA/cost targets.

Appreciate the quick turnaround —
Anika

Attachments: trial-usage-report.csv
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 09:10:00 -08:00
Subject: Fwd: OptiVize — request for 200K eval credits (bakeoff) — need discretionary exception

Team — forwarding OptiVize’s ask. They burned through the initial allocation and are requesting 200K eval credits plus a 2-week extension. I pre-approved a 75K immediate top-up (from growth promo) to keep them running while we evaluate.

Context / why this matters:
- Deal RD-2026-089 is in POC/Negotiation; procurement scoring window closes 11/23.
- OptiVize is doing a direct bakeoff against Vendor X; they say Vendor X provided ~200K credits.
- If we win this bakeoff, expected committed spend could be $180–240K ARR (estimated).

Ask: approve a discretionary one-time credit of up to 200K (tokens) contingent on OptiVize signing a short MA plan within 7 business days. Alternatively approve 150K as a middle ground we can offer without VP sign-off.

I’ve attached the trial-usage-report.csv and the RFP excerpt.

Thanks —
Markus
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 12:37:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: OptiVize — request for 200K eval credits (bakeoff) — need discretionary exception

Thanks for the quick context, Markus. I reviewed the usage report and the deal notes in HubSpot (link below). Given the potential ARR and the tight procurement timeline, I’ll approve a one-time 150K token credit from the discretionary promo pool, conditional on two things:

1) OptiVize signs a short MA plan (non-binding) confirming evaluation scope and a committed engagement discussion within 45 days.
2) CS (Evelyn) confirms we can provide engineering support for the final two scenarios if needed (low-touch assistance only).

If OptiVize insists on a full 200K match, we’ll need VP approval and a higher commitment from the buyer (12m committed minimum).

HubSpot: https://hubspot.company/deal/RD-2026-089

Markus — proceed to offer 150K + 2-week extension and capture the signed MA plan. Aditya, please flag spend in the promo ledger. Evelyn — can you confirm CS availability?

-Priyom
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
To: Anika Singh <anika@optivize.com>
Cc: procurement@optivize.com
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 15:47:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request: additional eval credits and short extension for RFP bakeoff

Hi Anika — good news. We can provide a one-time 150,000 eval credit top-up and extend your trial window by two weeks. This is conditional on OptiVize signing a short MA plan that outlines evaluation scope and confirms a committed engagement discussion within 45 days.

I’ve attached a short draft MA plan for signature; if that works, please sign and return and we’ll apply the credits immediately. If you need us to escalate for parity with Vendor X (200K), let us know and we’ll discuss VP-level approval but we’ll need a firmer commitment on minimum term/ARR.

Next steps:
- Please review and sign the attached: signed-ma-plan-draft.pdf (we can accept a countersigned DocuSign).
- Once we receive the signed MA plan, we’ll push 150K credits and confirm the new trial window.

Appreciate the quick cadence — good luck in the bakeoff. Let us know if you’d like a short session with one of our inference engineers this week.

Best,
Markus Klein
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
Attachments: signed-ma-plan-draft.pdf
